images.title: Three things dots and lines told us
images.purpose: A three item summary: the mean balances, a value above the mean pulls it up, a line graph shows change over time.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three equal cards in a row with wide gaps, each with one small picture and one short caption.
images.exact_structure: Three equal white cards with thin dark outlines in one row. Card 1: a short number line with 2 teal (#0072B2) dots and a reddish purple (#CC79A7) triangle under the line exactly halfway between them; caption the mean balances. Card 2: a short number line with 3 teal dots and 1 amber (#E69F00) dot to their right, and a reddish purple triangle with a small arrow pointing right; caption high value pulls up. Card 3: small axes with one teal line of 5 points rising and falling; caption change over time. No numbers anywhere.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The mean is a balance point that moves with the data, and line graphs show change over time.

image_decisions.why: A three card recap pulls the chapter's main ideas into one calm picture.
